works.title: Learning Method Book
works.description: A comprehensive book documenting his methodology for learning and thinking, structured in three pedagogical layers: tape-recorder method, mind-map synthesis, and AI-augmented genealogy. Built on analysis of 39,000+ archived AI conversations spanning 19 months as a RAG corpus for extracting learning patterns.
works.quote: Planning the 'learning method' book's three-layer structure, tape-recorder-to-mind-map-to-AI genealogy, and gearbox metaphor

works.title: LLM Model Selection Formula and Tool
works.description: A method and accompanying calculator for selecting large language models based on intelligence-per-dollar value ratio. Uses cost-elasticity of intelligence and Pareto frontier filtering rather than naive index/cost ratios. Organizes models into four preset buckets (premium/optimum/budget/free) with configurable intelligence floors. Designed to make AI model selection transparent and expose pricing inefficiencies in the market.
works.quote: Both cost-elasticity of intelligence and efficient-frontier filtering actually work: Compute Δindex / Δlog(cost) between adjacent models when sorted by price

works.title: Inside the Parliament Cartoon Series
works.description: An animated cartoon series depicting his internal parliament governance model — the deliberative process of different internal factions voting on decisions (ego, jester, body, long-term mission). Format is absurdist animation (similar to Being John Malkovich in tone). Deliberately non-prescriptive and guilt-free spiritual philosophy — showing his own mind's deliberation rather than teaching others. Designed as an indefinitely extensible project drawing directly from daily life and internal decision-making.
works.quote: I may have just stumbled across a long-term project I could add to indefinitely. Unlike most fiction I've imagined, this wouldn't have a natural endpoint... this cartoon series would be different because I'd be drawing directly from my daily life
